Edwin Starr was No.1 on the US chart with War.
Aneka was No.1 on the UK chart with Japanese Boy.

Def Leppard were No.1 on the UK album chart with Hysteria.

The Quarry Men played at the Casbah Coffee Club in Liverpool.
The Beatles played their last concert before a paying audience at Candlestick Park in San Francisco.
Led Zeppelin, The Youngbloods, Iron Butterfly and The Ides of March appeared at the Man Pop Festival in Winnipeg.
The Sex Pistols, supported by The Clash and The Buzzcocks, appeared at The Screen On The Green in London.
The Patti Smith Group played at City Hall in Newcastle.
The Rock on the Tyne festival began in Gateshead, featuring Ian Dury, Elvis Costello, U2, Rory Gallagher and Lindisfarne.
U2 played at Christchurch Town Hall in New Zealand.
Michael Jackson played at Roundhay Park in Leeds, England.
U2 played at Yankee Stadium in New York City.
The Police kicked off the European leg of their reunion tour at the Globe Arena in Stockholm.
Shirley Strachan, lead singer of Skyhooks, died in a helicopter crash.
Lee 'Scratch' Perry, pioneering Jamaican reggae and dub producer and innovator, died aged 85.
Ron Bushy, drummer for Iron Butterfly, died aged 79.
